institution.policyUnverifiedText: Items we could not confirm are excluded from the calculation rather than scored as zero (the weighted average is taken over known items only). Turning “unconfirmed” into a low score would be an unfounded claim.

scam.title: Scam pattern check
scam.subtitle: Compare your situation with the patterns below. We do not judge individual cases.
scam.noJudgement: We cannot tell you whether a specific call or message is a scam. Judging an individual case is for the investigative authorities. If you have any doubt, report it directly using the official numbers below.
scam.matchCount: {n} of the {total} known patterns match what you checked
scam.matchNote: The count is for reference only. However many match, we do not decide whether it is a scam — if in doubt, report it to 112.
scam.stepsTitle: If you have been harmed — in this order
scam.stepsNote: Payment suspension comes first. Stopping the money from leaving comes before the refund procedure.

product.title: Compare financial products
product.subtitle: Compare product terms from Financial Supervisory Service disclosures.
product.caveat: This compares product terms only. Whether a foreign resident can open the product is not in this data — confirm eligibility directly with the institution.
product.termHint: Without choosing a term, rates for different terms get mixed and the comparison does not hold.
product.undisclosedNote: This product does not disclose a rate. That means unknown, not 0% — it is placed at the end of the list.
product.unavailable: Product information cannot be loaded right now. This does not mean there are no products — please try again shortly.

remittance.title: Remittance simulator
remittance.subtitle: Converts at the daily published mid-market rate and shows only verified limits.
remittance.ytdHint: You enter this yourself. This service does not look up your actual remittance history.
remittance.rateStale: The latest quote could not be retrieved, so the last received value is used. The rate actually applied may differ.
remittance.rateUnavailable: The exchange rate could not be retrieved. Limit guidance below is still available.
remittance.limitUnknownNote: This service has not yet verified a primary source for the limit figures. It shows no amount and does not judge whether you are within the limit.

terms.title: Terms and notices
terms.purposeBody: It finds published laws, regulations and official guidance and organises them for your residence status. Every answer shows the source document and when we last verified it.
terms.notTitle: What this service does not do
terms.notAdvice: It does not recommend or solicit investments, loans or product sign-ups. Product comparison lists disclosed terms only, and the ranking criteria are published.
terms.notApproval: It does not predict or decide the outcome of any individual review. Account approval, loan limits, applicable rates, and whether a particular contact is a scam are for the institution and the investigative authorities to determine.
terms.notRecord: There is no sign-up and conversations are not stored on the server. The profile you enter stays in your browser and is discarded after the request is handled.
terms.authorityBody: Guidance here may differ from what a branch actually does. Requirements, documents and limits vary by institution and change often. Please confirm with the financial institution before visiting. We accept no liability for outcomes based on this guidance.
terms.aiBody: Answers generated by AI are labelled as such. When no evidence is found, or when a question concerns an individual review, no answer is generated and official channels are given instead.
terms.privacyBody: We never ask for your registration number, account number or password. If such information is detected in the input box it is masked without being stored and a notice is shown. Any contact asking for this information is a scam.
terms.contactBody: For financial consultation call the Financial Supervisory Service at 1332; to report voice phishing call 112. For residence status enquiries call Hi Korea at 1345.
